words.enExample: It's never too late to restart with what you've learned.
words.zhExample: 带着你学到的东西重新开始，永远不嫌晚。
words.note: re-（重新）+ start（开始）。比 begin again 更干脆，常用于项目、关系、习惯的重启。名词 restart。近义：renew / reboot。

words.enExample: Don't hesitate to ask for help when you're stuck.
words.zhExample: 卡住的时候，别犹豫，去求助。
words.note: 词根含“粘住”之意 → 像被粘住迈不动脚。hesitate to do sth. 固定搭配。名词 hesitation。近义：pause / waver；反义：dare。

words.enExample: Once you start, momentum carries you forward.
words.zhExample: 一旦开始，势头就会推着你往前走。
words.note: 物理“动量”，比喻做事的“惯性推进力”。gain / build / keep momentum（获得 / 积累 / 保持势头）。近义：drive / impetus。

words.enExample: Embrace the messy early stage instead of fearing it.
words.zhExample: 欣然接纳那个笨拙的初期，而不是害怕它。
words.note: em-（入）+ brace（臂）→ 用双臂围住，引申“热情接受新事物”。embrace change / uncertainty。近义：accept / welcome；反义：reject。

words.enExample: A setback is just data, not a verdict on your worth.
words.zhExample: 挫折只是数据，不是对你价值的判决。
words.note: set（使）+ back（后退）→ 让进度后退一步。suffer a setback / recover from a setback。近义：obstacle / reversal；反义：progress。

essay.title: The Courage to Begin Again
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: Every ending carries a beginning inside it, though we rarely notice while grieving what we lost. The project that failed, the habit that slipped, the version of ourselves we thought we'd be—all of it can become the ground we start from, not the wall we stop at.
Beginning again asks for less than we fear. Not a perfect plan, only the next small honest step. You do not have to be ready; you only have to be willing to move, and let momentum gather as you go.

So if you stalled, begin. If you fell, begin. The page does not care how many times you restarted; it only waits for the next true line. Courage, it turns out, is mostly just beginning again—quietly, and one more time.
translations: 每一次结束都内含着一个开始，尽管我们在为失去而哀伤时很少察觉。那个失败的项目、那个中断的习惯、我们曾以为会成为的自己——这一切，都可以成为我们起步的土壤，而非止步的高墙。
重新开始，所求比我们恐惧的要少。不是一份完美的计划，只是下一个微小而真诚的脚步。你不必万事俱备；你只需愿意迈步，并让势头在行进中自行汇聚。
所以，若你停下了，就重新开始。若你跌倒了，就重新开始。纸页不在乎你重来了多少次；它只等待下一行真诚的字。原来，勇气多半不过是：再重新开始一次——安静地，再一次。

grammar.example: "though we rarely notice while grieving what we lost."
"Not a perfect plan, only the next small honest step. You do not have to be ready; you only have to be willing to move, and let momentum gather as you go."

vocab.enExample: We rarely notice the beginning while grieving what we lost.
vocab.zhExample: 在为失去的一切悲伤时，我们很少留意到那个开端。
vocab.note: grieve for/over sb.；grief 为名词（悲伤）。比 sad 更重、更持久。近义 mourn / lament；反义 rejoice / celebrate。

vocab.enExample: The habit that slipped can become the ground we start from.
vocab.zhExample: 那个没能坚持住的习惯，可以成为我们重新起步的土壤。
vocab.note: 本义「滑倒」。let sth. slip 意为「让…溜走」。名词 a slip of the tongue（口误）。近义 slide / lapse；反义 hold on。

vocab.meaning: 坦诚的；实在的，不掺假的
vocab.enExample: Not a perfect plan, only the next small honest step.
vocab.zhExample: 不需要完美的计划，只要下一个小小而实在的步骤。
vocab.note: 此处 honest 修饰 step，意为「不自我欺骗的一步」。honest work 意为「踏实的活」。近义 sincere / genuine；反义 dishonest。

vocab.enExample: Let momentum gather as you go.
vocab.zhExample: 让势头在你前行的过程中慢慢积聚。
vocab.note: 物理术语「动量」，引申为「越做越顺的推动力」。搭配 gain/build/lose momentum。近义 drive / impetus；反义 stagnation。

vocab.enExample: You only have to be willing to move.
vocab.zhExample: 你只需要愿意迈出步子就够了。
vocab.note: be willing to do sth.。原文对比 ready（准备好）与 willing（愿意），是全段关键。近义 ready / disposed；反义 reluctant / unwilling。

vocab.zhExample: 所以，如果你停滞了，那就重新开始。
vocab.note: 本义「（发动机）熄火」，引申为「进展卡住」。也作「拖延」讲：stall for time。近义 stumble / halt；反义 surge ahead。

vocab.enExample: The page does not care how many times you restarted.
vocab.zhExample: 那张纸并不在意你重来了多少次。
vocab.note: re-（再）+ start。名词 restart。近义 begin again / reboot；反义 give up / abandon。

vocab.enExample: Courage, it turns out, is mostly just beginning again.
vocab.zhExample: 原来，勇气多半不过是重新开始。
vocab.note: 作插入语时等于 it happens that。也可作「生产、关灯」讲。近义 prove to be / end up being。
